meta.title: Contact — Let's understand the business
meta.description: Tell us what you are trying to understand about your business. A person reads it, a short conversation follows, and you get a straight answer about whether Forcelis can help.

hero.title: Let's understand the business.
hero.subtitle: Tell us what you're trying to understand. We'll tell you whether Forcelis can help.

form.name: Name
form.message: What are you trying to understand?
form.messageHint: A specific question makes the first conversation more useful. One or two sentences are enough.
form.consent: I have read the Privacy Policy and consent to Forcelis processing this information in order to respond.
form.successBody: Thank you. We will get back to you at the email address you provided.
form.errorTitle: The message could not be sent.
form.errorBody: Something went wrong on the way. Please try again in a few minutes.
form.unconfiguredTitle: The form is not connected yet.
form.unconfiguredBody: This site has no form endpoint configured, so nothing would be delivered. Set PUBLIC_FORM_ENDPOINT before publishing — see the README.

errors.email: Enter a valid email address — for example, name@company.com
errors.minLength: Please write a little more — at least {min} characters.
errors.url: Enter a website address like company.com, or leave the field empty.
errors.consent: Accept the Privacy Policy to continue.

steps.title: We read it
steps.body: A person reviews your message, not a routing rule.

steps.title: 30 minutes
steps.body: A short conversation to understand the business and the question. No preparation needed.

steps.title: Concrete next step
steps.body: Scope and approach based on the discussion, not on a standard package.

items.title: No tax credentials
items.body: Forcelis never asks for tax portal access.

items.title: No banking credentials
items.body: Analysis works from files you export yourself.

items.title: No obligation
items.body: A first conversation is confidential, whether or not an engagement follows.
